notes.title: March Update!
notes.content:
Hello All!

To coincide with the steam sale, I figured I'd go ahead and drop this update! I originally wanted to have the new map ready to drop at this time but that didn't pan out as I have sadly had to spend most of my time lately on my laptop (which cannot even open the Take a Walk Project lol).

BUT! I still have something for you. Now on the main menu you can choose between 4 unique followers. A Fox, Capybara, Wolf, and Bear. All they do is follow you and you can choose to have no follower as well. 

It isn't perfect and I'm aware of that but I didn't want this promotion to come and go without atleast giving you guys SOMETHING as a thank you!

--Ed

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.5.3
notes.content:
OK, this time we are doing it right

The following fixes have been implemented

--Level select screen within the pause menu now returns you to pause menu

--Fixed the obvious incorrect build version issue

--Fixed issue with the bunnies (seriously they are relentless)

--removed motion blur



The following CHANGES have been implemented:

--You can now turn on or off the totem collection noise

--The Nature Reserve has been updated (fixed broken models and textures as well as beautified the map a bit)

--The overworld map no longer shows you where the totems are located. Now, instead of them being on the map, they will appear on the minimap when you are within a certain range



THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR PATIENCE! YOU ALL ARE THE BEST!

notes.title: Version 1.1.4.1 (Pls be the last one this indie dev stuff is hard)
notes.content:
OK.... So this should be one of the last patches for launch

Fixed the following Items

--The sky texture broke so there were no stars

--Fixed yet another issue with animal population

--Fixed out of bounds achievement bug

--Pressing Shift or Left thumb stick now multiplies the movement speed x2.5 rather than hard setting it so you dont ahve to re-adjust 

--Adjusted some variables so walk speed, autowalkspeed, volume, etc stay when switching between levels

--Corrected some Timings with time of day setting

--Added a flashlight to the autowalking camera that is toggled the same way as the other flash light

--You guys are all the best , honestly this feed back ive gotten is INSANEEEEE so again thank you. And the first person to message me on discord will get a free key to give to a friend :)
